must_identify: The refactor only adds directories, re-exports, a type alias, and a pass-through call; it does not create ownership, API, dependency, lifecycle, or test boundaries.
Feature importance and a possible display addition are not evidence for deeper architecture.
The structure should remain or become simpler unless a concrete business invariant or coordination responsibility emerges.
acceptable: Reject or collapse the proposed layers and colocate the simple flow.
Keep only an extraction that has a current, named responsibility and independently improves the contract.
Describe the evidence that would justify rerunning the level decision later.
must_not: Approve the refactor because domain/application/presentation names look architecturally clean.
Suggest filling every layer with more wrappers or interfaces to justify the move.
Use future complexity or feature importance as sufficient evidence.
Treat import paths as proof of a changed dependency direction.
